_about: Real questions people asked Ask (owner 2026-11-16: every real question becomes a permanent test, run nightly by tools.hard_benchmark). Each chat runs in order; a turn's brand is decided from its own words and the earlier user turns, as the live turn does. Checks are on GROUNDING only (rule 21: no legal conclusion is asserted): `gold` slots the seed search must show (any ref of a slot meets it), `must_show` patterns that the shown text must contain (figures as published today), `must_not_show` patterns no shown text may contain (superseded figures). How to add one: ops/README.md, 'Real-question regression'.

chats.source: Sales head, Ask chat 2026-10-08 (one chat, three turns)

turns.q: if the client has made an annual contract and gives a termination notice after 4 months and there is no issue with service, is this allowed as per MSA
turns.note: Our MSA's term / early-termination position as ratified (Constitution 14 / 31.2, the early-termination standard).

turns.q: if the customer serice is down for 6 hours. has the SLA been breached for this month. calculate the damages as per the SLA policy
turns.note: No brand named: the published SLA credit table (Leapswitch 15/40/100 %, CloudPe 5/10/20 %), never the retired 10/25/50 % or 30 days. The credit table may come inside the SLA page's own record, so the figures, not the section ref, are the check.

turns.q: the customer billing is 14500 per month. now calculate the credit due to customer
gold: PUB:PUBLISHED_SLA_LEAPSWITCH:How to Request a Service Credit
PUB:PUBLISHED_SLA_CLOUDPE:How to Request a Service Credit
turns.note: The credit on the published scale and the 60-day claim window.
